criteria: Original grocery cohort plus first 10 unique valid GTINs in each US category listing. Initial listings sorted by last modification; one availability retry may use provider scan-count ordering. If categories remain unavailable, fill remaining slots round-robin from unused available listing records, before any scoring. No nutrient, ingredient, additive, grade or completeness fields requested during selection.
limitations: Purposive recent-record sample, not a random or national coverage estimate. Provider US availability claims do not establish US formulation.
